# Example Store

> Example Store sells garden tools. This file lists the pages that explain what we sell and how to order.

## Products
- [Hand tools](https://www.example.com/hand-tools): spades, forks and trowels
- [Watering](https://www.example.com/watering): hoses, cans and timers

## Help
- [Delivery](https://www.example.com/delivery): costs and times
- [Returns](https://www.example.com/returns): how to send an item back
